purpose: Branding concepts for maintainer selection; not production assets.

options.name: 01 Stack
options.initial:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a polished landscape identity concept board for an open source Rust MCP server named exactly "mcp-komodo-rs". It connects MCP clients to Komodo to inspect stacks and builds and perform authorized deployment operations. No product dashboard exists here; show branding applications only, not fabricated screenshots. This is a design exploration, not a security certification.
Composition: spacious carefully aligned landscape board. One large primary symbol and exact wordmark in upper area, two shallow README header specimens below (one light, one dark), a small truly single-ink logo specimen and four palette swatches at bottom. Consistent mark geometry across specimens. Flat vector-like precision in a raster image. Large readable typography, substantial whitespace. Exact text only: concept title specified below, "mcp-komodo-rs", "Komodo operations for MCP clients", and small specimen labels "Light", "Dark", "One ink". No other copy, no hex labels, no fake code, no watermark.
Avoid generic AI sparkle, gradients, glow, glossy 3D, shields, padlocks, Rust crabs, stock network globes, visual clutter. Must have strong silhouette suitable for later vector drawing and small icons. Project name stays lowercase with all hyphens.
Concept title: "01 / Stack". A warm precise identity: three horizontal rounded open trays aligned as a compact vertical stack, one small copper connection ring completes the middle tray at the right, with the negative space subtly suggesting K. Symbol is recognizably layered operations, not a terminal chevron. Palette warm ivory #F7F5F0, ink #23201B, deep forest #1E5F46, restrained copper #B66A45. Humanist geometric sans-serif wordmark with the visual character of Manrope, medium weight. Restrained rounded strokes, clear flat fills, almost editorial layout. This option should sit naturally beside Waygate and mcp-ssh-rs but have its own mark. In the dark sample use warm charcoal and ivory, copper only as a small brand accent. One ink specimen must contain only one foreground color.
options.correction: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the attached concept board. Keep the logo geometry, exact wording, palette swatches, and overall layout unchanged. Correct only the backgrounds and lighting: replace the entire black and glowing outer board background with uniform opaque warm ivory #F7F5F0. Remove every glow, shadow, vignette, texture, and lighting effect throughout. All outer-board text must be solid ink #23201B, fully legible. The light header specimen remains flat ivory with ink lettering. The dark header specimen alone remains solid warm charcoal, its letters ivory and its stack symbol pale ivory with a copper ring, so the mark has clear contrast. The bottom one-ink logo uses solid ink only on the ivory background. Everything is flat, clean, crisp. This is a printed graphic design board, not a lit scene. Preserve all exact text including "01 / Stack" and "mcp-komodo-rs".
